senses.definition: A car where the engine has been replaced by a General Motors LS-series internal combustion gasoline engine.
To replace the engine of a car with a GM LS-series internal combustion gasoline engine, that was not originally so equipped.
Pertaining to cars where the engine has been replaced by a GM LS-series internal combustion gasoline engine.
